title: Runtime Policy Containment Certification
gateStatement: Scratch compatibility execution rate is independent from presentation refresh; Pen/renderer limitations are detected, not hidden.
certifiedProperties: Execution and Presentation mutations are independent through the production Command/Authority/Adapter path.
30 Hz Scratch-compatible simulation can coexist with display-refresh presentation.
Legacy project FPS maps only to Execution and cannot silently replace Presentation policy.
Legacy precedence is resolved per semantic key and preserves blocked lower-precedence intent.
_twconfig_ is restricted to explicit Legacy import/export boundaries.
Pen and Stamp exact-tick limitations are explicit under high-refresh presentation.
Unknown/custom renderer domains fail visibly when PresenterCapability is missing.
Backend capability failure is reported separately from semantic Presentation compatibility.
Compatibility analysis and profile preview are query-only.
Legacy unbounded clone intent remains bounded by Host hard ceiling.
Advanced Settings has no direct Runtime Policy VM/Renderer writer.
The C01-C17 representative compatibility corpus remains active.

aggregateGate.observedProcessExit: not observed due outer execution-window timeout during repeated real Webpack compile

governance.note: LRC-G1 certifies containment invariants; LRC-2 remains the Architecture Frozen Runtime Policy contract.
